defaults.label: Anyone with the link
defaults.summary: Anyone who gets the link can open it.

defaults.label: Only the first person
defaults.summary: Works for whoever opens it first. Then it’s used up.

defaults.label: People you invite
defaults.summary: Only the email addresses you add can open it.

defaults.label: People you approve
defaults.summary: They confirm their email and ask. You approve each person.

public.label: Anyone with the link
public.summary: Anyone who gets the link can open it.

email_capture.label: Anyone with a verified email
email_capture.summary: Anyone can open it after confirming their email.
email_capture.if_forwarded: Opens once they confirm their own email.
email_capture.they_will: Confirm their email with a passkey or an emailed link.

email_domain.label: Work or school email
email_domain.summary: Only people with an email at your domain can open it.
email_domain.if_forwarded: Opens only with an email at your domain.
email_domain.they_will: Confirm a work or school email with a passkey or an emailed link.

invite_only.label: People you invite
invite_only.summary: Only the email addresses you add can open it.
invite_only.they_will: Confirm the invited email with a passkey or an emailed link.

review.label: People you approve
review.summary: They confirm their email and ask. You approve each person.
review.if_forwarded: They can ask. It stays closed until you approve.
review.they_will: Confirm their email with a passkey or an emailed link, then wait for you.
review.you_will_see: Each request, before anyone gets in.

keys.label: Devices you approve
keys.summary: No email needed. They send you their passkey’s details, and you approve it.
keys.if_forwarded: They can send their own passkey details. It stays closed until you approve.
keys.they_will: Create a passkey and send you its approval details.

contract.label: Custom access
contract.summary: Your app or service decides who gets in.
